quantifiers.why: The universal is over the screen's own input set, not over the proteome. The paper's sentence is 'By screening 630,003 protein pairs' (c3), and figures.json asserts 630,003 equals every pairing of the curated 1123 (c2). The frame says the screen read every pair of that list, which is what the paper states it did.
